note: English DEV set, written on 2026-09-26 before the English rule family existed, then used while building it: every rule was tuned against these sentences, so a perfect score here is expected and proves little. It is not a held-out set. Stated verdicts are the ones the product must never give (coverage of every clause, compliance with the tender / ITT / specification / contract / code, approval, readiness or permission to submit / book / ship / bid / start, passing a review, no risk of disqualification). Look-alikes that must pass: negated, asked, conditional, tender requirements, quoted and reported sentences, and plain record facts (one statement's status, the plan's figures). The 21 cases whose id starts with en2- and the 9 whose id starts with en3- were added later the same day, while building the second and third passes of the family, and are dev as well. Sentences are SYNTHETIC.
